name: date-picker
blurb: Smart date picker with natural language input and calendar popover.
description: An input field that parses natural language dates (like 'tomorrow', 'next Friday') via chrono-node. Shows a calendar popover for visual selection. Triggers on focus with no time picker.
use_when: Users prefer typing dates naturally or selecting from a calendar.
avoid_when: Highly structured forms where free-form input could cause validation errors.
a11y: Input is keyboard-accessible with clear focus states. Calendar is navigable with arrow keys.
